<!-- great-pm PR format — every section is required; delete none.
     Rulebook: skills/pr-authoring/SKILL.md -->

## Reviewer summary

### Why
<!-- The gap or problem this PR addresses — 2–4 sentences, readable without opening the diff. -->

### Outcome
<!-- What this PR delivers, in one paragraph. -->

### Out of scope
<!-- What this PR deliberately does NOT include — code, secrets, deployment, config, unrelated fixes. -->

## Decision requested
<!-- Exactly what approving this PR means, what happens after merge, and what approval does NOT authorize. -->

## Tracking and design context
<!-- Links: tracker issue, upstream approved artifacts (PRD / strategy / ADRs), decision IDs this traces to. -->
- Issue:
- Upstream artifact(s):

## Change map

| Area | What changed | Why it changed |
|---|---|---|
|  |  |  |

## Suggested review order
<!-- Highest-risk contract first. -->

| Step | File or artifact | What to verify |
|---|---|---|
| 1 |  |  |

## Acceptance criteria and evidence

| Acceptance criterion | Implementation | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
|  |  |  |

## Verification performed
<!-- Real commands + real results. Screenshot/video for UI changes; explicit "not applicable because…" otherwise. -->

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
|  |  |

## Risk and impact
<!-- "No change" is a valid entry but must be stated, never implied by omission. -->

| Dimension | Material impact and mitigation |
|---|---|
| Security |  |
| Privacy/data |  |
| Cost |  |
| Operations/observability |  |
| Compatibility |  |

## Limitations and follow-up
<!-- What this PR honestly does not solve; follow-up issues filed. -->

## Rollback
<!-- Before merge: close without merging — anything to restore? After merge: exact revert path + what to verify. "No rollback applies" must be justified. -->

## Handoff checklist
<!-- Check a box ONLY after actually doing the check. -->

- [ ] The title describes the outcome, not the implementation activity.
- [ ] The summary can be understood without reading the tracker discussion.
- [ ] The requested reviewer decision and post-merge actions are explicit.
- [ ] The suggested review order starts with the highest-risk contract.
- [ ] Every acceptance criterion maps to implementation and evidence.
- [ ] Every number is labeled as an approved target or a measured result.
- [ ] No secrets, private data, unsupported claims, or stale status remain.
- [ ] The rollback path is stated and, where applicable, tested.
